role.purpose: Persistent transport and node connectivity for Vera and authorized machines.
role.status: Large WorkBridge/VeraPort/Lappy activation stack remains open.
role.current_frontier: Collapse stacked activation work into one qualified transport path.

build_tracks.goal: Converge the VeraPort/VeraMesh activation stack onto one qualified transport route.
acceptance: One route owns each live listener.
Handshake and capability negotiation are explicit.

build_tracks.goal: Keep WorkBridge delegation narrow, authenticated and scope-bound.
acceptance: Filesystem effects remain within authorized roots.

build_tracks.goal: Make activation and recovery rollback exact and observable.
acceptance: Rollback restores the prior runtime subject.
Partial activation is distinguishable from success.
Readback verifies service/config state after effects.
